To: All Staff

Thank you for your continued support of our company. We are pleased to announce that the annual employee workshop will be held on May 18. The workshop will focus on improving communication with customers.

The workshop will _____ at 9:00 A.M. and will continue until noon. All employees are encouraged to attend, especially those who regularly communicate with customers. Please register by May 10 so that we can prepare enough materials for all participants.

We look forward to seeing you at the workshop.
